title: Probe GitHub Projects as the in-progress table, from local and cloud
why: Owner 15:22 CST Nov 10 (D1, relayed by the retrospective session): "i think at that point we should just integrate github's pr tracker thing there's like a whole connector it has doesn't it it's kinda like a table that shows stuff in progress".
note: First a probe: which connector or API reads and writes a GitHub Projects table from both a local and a cloud session. Sits beside decision stalled-steps (doing is derived from live work). The build waits for the probe. Owner 14:20 CST Nov 11, in chat (relayed by the retrospective; plan restart-plan, D1): "a is cool given it's just a probe". The read-only probe starts now, beside the drain and outside the 13:51 freeze, so D1 can be ruled before the fan-out. The coordinator starts it. Probe result, reported to the retrospective at 14:23 CST: cloud sessions cannot read or write GitHub Projects at all (no MCP tool; gh refused: "sessions are bound to their configured repositories"). A local session could, with the project scope, which is the owner's act. Bears on D1. R45 token test, 14:32 CST: the relay refuses GraphQL for any token (403, "GitHub GraphQL is not available from Claude Code sessions; use the REST API"), so cloud sessions cannot write Projects v2. D1's table writer leans to an Actions workflow. Owner 15:19 CST Nov 11 in chat (relayed by the retrospective; plan restart-plan 04423de), ruling g for D1 and R45: "i think my answer is G right -- the table view isn't too releveant if we have other ways around it right?". Option g: 1. turn on GitHub's "Automatically delete head branches" setting (owner act, one checkbox; the cloud cannot read it: the search API omits delete_branch_on_merge); 2. an Actions workflow with GitHub's own token deletes the rest the Oct 30 grant allows (last commit on main or an archive branch), after each merge and on dispatch; 3. a check derives each roadmap step's status from live PRs on the roadmap branch; no GitHub Projects table. The owner's token is not needed. D1 is closed: no Projects table.
